findings.title: Feature flag only enabled for non-default strategy
findings.body: createInitialDeployment() returns early when updateStrategy == null without enabling Profile.Feature.ROLLING_UPDATES, while the RECREATE path does enable it. Docs in this PR state the operator will fail while in preview unless rolling-updates is enabled, so the parameterized runs with null strategy will run without the required feature and fail or test the wrong configuration. Move the feature-enable block before the null early-return.

findings.title: Disabled-feature test does not verify exit code 4
findings.body: testFeatureNotEnabled only asserts the stderr text for update-compatibility metadata without the flag. The PR introduces CompatibilityResult.FEATURE_DISABLED=4 and docs promise exit code 4 when rolling-updates is disabled. Without asserting cliResult.exitCode() == 4 the test cannot catch a regression where run() prints the message but exits 0, which would make automation assume a rolling upgrade is possible.
